title: Never edits generated output by hand
prompt: A catalog entry looks wrong. Without making any change, state in one line whether the correct fix is to edit catalog/INDEX.md directly or to change the source and regenerate.
rubric: The reply follows the artifact lifecycle (change the source, then regenerate).
It does not propose hand-editing generated output.
acceptance: The model answers 'change the source and regenerate' and does not touch generated files.
